items.title: Tell HN: HN is being scraped for emails to scam
Meet Meta’s JiTTests: LLM-Generated Tests Designed to Fail Before Risky Code Lands
items.excerpt: Meta has moved Catching JiTTests into production. The LLM system writes tests designed to fail on risky diffs, and caught 74 privacy SEVs before landing in H1 2026, with a 60% engineer-reported true-positive rate. The post Meet Meta’s JiTTests: LLM-Generated Tests Designed to Fail Before Risky Code Lands appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen4-Max: 2.4T MoE, 71B Active, 1M Context
items.excerpt: Alibaba released Qwen4-Max, a proprietary 2.4T-parameter MoE model with 71B active parameters, native vision and a 1M-token context. It costs $1.5/M input tokens and cuts Work360 cost per task by 62%. The post Alibaba Releases Qwen4-Max: 2.4T MoE, 71B Active, 1M Context appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.title: Hark Releases Handoff², a 2x Faster Computer-Use Agent for Hark Pro
items.excerpt: Hark has released Handoff², the computer-use agent inside Hark Pro. It averages 2x faster than v1, completes 82% of 478 internal web tasks, and learned to batch actions through latency-penalized RL. The post Hark Releases Handoff², a 2x Faster Computer-Use Agent for Hark Pro appeared first on MarkTechPost .
